issues.message: Indexable page has no canonical URL
The page's content sits inside an iframe and is not attributed to this URL
issues.fix_hint: Serve the framed copy in the page's own HTML. A search engine attributes an iframe's text to the framed document, not to the page that frames it, so the copy exists and earns this URL nothing.
Add a useful meta description, typically up to about 160 characters.

issues.message: Live page is blocked by robots.txt despite receiving internal links
issues.fix_hint: robots.txt blocks crawling, not indexing, so link discovery is lost. Make the URL crawlable with a more specific Allow rule than the matching Disallow, and control indexing with canonical or noindex. A common case is pagination such as /blog?page=N blocked by Disallow: /*?.

issues.fix_hint: Review the Disallow rules that hid the quoted targets: a rule broad enough to block an internal link target removes that section from every robots-respecting crawler.
